hypothesis: The review-clean package preserves the validated dense6x1024 training and evaluation behavior while removing reviewer-confusing eval-path constructs, so it will pass the submission contract, reproduce the source checkpoint's 0.9928513116311253 public BPB, and complete a cold 1800-second full-chip rehearsal with a valid checkpoint.
single_causal_change: Relative to submissions/dense6x1024_public0992851, only the mechanically documented reviewer-facing cleanup in submissions/dense6x1024_lean_review is under test; the model, optimizer, kernels, data path, timing budget, and launch command are unchanged.

control.box_constraint: Use trn22, the same host as the preserved cold source-package rehearsal; compare exact launch shape, charged training time, checkpoint validity, and public scorer output.

candidate.expected_diff: No new train.py edit. Validate the existing review-clean artifact at SHA-256 9173f62617789b058083c3a4722a906e2b165f4986716281f1915db3fb9fa344.

success_criteria.quality: Source-checkpoint replay equals 0.9928513116311253 BPB; a fresh checkpoint is evaluated and reported without claiming an official private-shard win.
success_criteria.throughput: Cold rehearsal stays within the 1800-second charged training budget and produces a step count comparable with the 3634-step source rehearsal.
success_criteria.correctness: Organizer check, independent rules review, CPU and Neuron contract checks, causality, clean-host postflight, checkpoint load, and protected public evaluation all pass with no crash or NaN.

abort_conditions: Any organizer, independent-review, contract, causality, checkpoint, NaN, budget, or host-cleanliness gate fails
The candidate train.py or launch command differs from the frozen package hashes
The machine is not clean and idle or has less than 5 GiB free
